milestones.title: Foundations: mission control and product definition
Phase 0: weighed Brazilian benchmark, evaluation engine and baselines
Phase 1: on-device single-photo MVP passing the phase-1 accuracy gate

acceptance.criterion: Every gate passes on a known-good fixture and is proven to fail on at least one broken fixture
Claude Code hooks: silent when macrofy is untouched, block turn end on gate failure or missing handoff, release when stuck, re-inject the brief after compaction
The live Macrofy control state and documentation pass every fast gate

tasks.title: Define Macrofy's mission, goals, non-goals and first product milestone with the owner

acceptance.criterion: The owner approved control/mission.json (status approved) and ADR 0002 (Status: Accepted), including the open platform and data-collection decisions
A product milestone exists whose tasks cover every product goal, each with check-backed acceptance criteria

tasks.title: Benchmark tooling: meal manifest schema, capture protocol, validator with frozen test split and leakage rules

acceptance.criterion: Validator rejects leakage (same household or near-duplicate photo across splits), unhashed test-set changes and malformed weights, each proven by a negative fixture

tasks.title: Evaluation engine: per-sample MAPE, signed bias, within-±10/20/30%, Bland-Altman, interval coverage, cluster-bootstrap 95% CI

acceptance.criterion: Every metric matches hand-computed values on synthetic fixtures, and the CI procedure bootstraps by household

tasks.title: Food vocabulary and nutrient mapping v0: Brazilian classes mapped to TACO/FNDDS with state, method and default-oil facets and FNDDS-derived densities

acceptance.criterion: Every class resolves to a nutrient entry, has all three facets and a density; licenses of every bundled source are recorded

tasks.title: Collect 300 weighed meals (150 calibration, 150 locked test) following the capture protocol

acceptance.criterion: Benchmark has >=300 meals from >=10 households with per-item weights and passes the validator
Owner confirms the weighing protocol was followed

tasks.title: Experiment: metric scale error of single-frame AR plane (and LiDAR where available) at 25-40 cm

acceptance.criterion: Written result with scale error distribution on >=30 captures across >=2 phones, reviewed independently

tasks.title: On-device MVP (segment, classify, depth, AR scale, volume, density, nutrients, one-tap confirm, conformal ranges) passes the phase-1 gate

acceptance.criterion: Locked test set: upper 95% CI of meal kcal MAPE <=30%, item mass MAPE <=35%, |bias| <=10%, 80% ranges cover 75-85%
On a 2024+ phone with no network: result in <=2 s and <=1 confirmation tap for a typical plate
